subject: Film & Cinema
title: What Makes a Genre?
description: A micro-lesson that makes What Makes a Genre? usable.

hook.text: You know an action movie when you see one. But what exactly makes it 'action'?

buildup.text: Genres are patterns — recurring settings, tones, plots, and character types audiences expect.

discovery.text: Studios use genres to market films. Audiences use them to choose what to watch.

twist.text: The best films often blend genres, making strict classification nearly impossible.

climax.text: Genres aren't rules — they're a shared language between filmmakers and audiences.

quiz.question: What is a film genre fundamentally?
options: A pattern of recurring elements audiences recognize
